articles.title: GIANT is Production Ready
articles.description: How to build a framework in 300 lines of code.
articles.body: It's just JavaScript. No build steps, no virtual DOM diffing bottlenecks, just pure prefix-matched DOM updates and explicit state tracking. By leveraging native Proxy objects and standard HTML element creation, GIANT achieves O(1) attribute updates and microscopic SSR serialization. Welcome to the future of vanilla-flavored web development.

articles.title: The State of SSR Today
articles.description: Why Server-Side Rendering is still king for content.
articles.body: SEO, Time-To-Interactive, and baseline performance metrics all point to one thing: sending HTML over the wire is still the most efficient way to deliver content. Hydration overhead in massive frameworks is a known issue, which is why hybrid architectures like GIANT aim to merge the best of both worlds: pre-rendered HTML with targeted, state-driven client components.
